2608.23752.title: Too much of a good thing -- when knowledge distillation promotes overfitting, and how to avoid it
2608.23752.paper_summary: The growing size of Convolutional Neural Networks has led to increasingly large and costly models. Knowledge Distillation (KD) addresses this by transferring knowledge from a large network (teacher) to a small one (student), also reducing the training data required. KD is traditionally applied only at the network's final output. However, its behaviour when applied at intermediate network layers has received little attention. This raises the question of whether intermediate block-wise KD, which provides supervision throughout the network, could offer an advantage under specific conditions, such as few instances per class, which is common in fine-grained datasets. This work proposes a student design based on simple, homogeneous blocks mirroring those of the teacher, distilling knowledge between corresponding blocks. Across eleven datasets, we show that on classic datasets, distilling only the last block is sufficient -- and often best--, whereas fine-grained, data-scarce settings benefit substantially from intermediate supervision, with even a single additional distillation point narrowing the gap considerably. We further study how this supervision should be guided, exploring configurations of varying granularity and informed by an explainability analysis based on attention maps, Centered Kernel Alignment, and Grad-CAM, alongside the impact of teacher and student fine-tuning strategies. This work shows that intermediate block-wise distillation, guided appropriately, is key to building compact data-efficient models without sacrificing accuracy.
2608.23752.paper_summary_zh: 隨著卷積神經網絡的規模不斷增長，導致了模型越來越大且成本高昂。知識蒸餾（KD）通過將知識從大型網絡（教師）轉移到小型網絡（學生），來解決這一問題，同時減少所需的訓練數據。KD 傳統上僅應用於網絡的最終輸出。然而，當應用於中間網絡層時，其行為卻鮮有關注。這引發了這樣的問題：中間區塊級 KD 是否能在特定條件下提供優勢，例如每類別實例較少，這在細粒度數據集中很常見。本研究提出了一種基於簡單、同質區塊的學生設計，這些區塊與教師的區塊相對應，並在相應的區塊之間進行知識蒸餾。在十一個數據集上，我們顯示在經典數據集上，僅蒸餾最後一個區塊就足夠了——而且通常是最佳的——而在細粒度、數據稀缺的情況下，中間監督帶來了顯著的好處，甚至僅一個額外的蒸餾點就能顯著縮小差距。我們進一步研究這種監督應該如何引導，探索不同粒度的配置，並通過基於注意力圖、中心核對齊和 Grad-CAM 的可解釋性分析來提供信息，還有教師和學生微調策略的影響。本研究表明，適當引導的中間區塊級蒸餾是構建緊湊且數據高效模型的關鍵，而不會犧牲準確性。
